command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== normalise all three callers identically, confident SNVs (QUAL>=20), compare on POS:REF:ALT =="
for f in gatk:gatk.vcf.gz bcftools:bcftools.vcf.gz freebayes:freebayes.vcf; do
  n=${f%%:*}; v=${f##*:}
  bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m- "$v" -Oz -o $n.norm.vcf.gz 2>/dev/null
  bcftools view -H -v snps -i 'QUAL>=20' $n.norm.vcf.gz 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2":"$4":"$5}' | sort -u > $n.snv
done
jac(){ i=$(comm -12 "$1" "$2"|wc -l|tr -d ' '); u=$(cat "$1" "$2"|sort -u|wc -l|tr -d ' '); awk -v i=$i -v u=$u 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f",(u>0)?i/u:0}'; }
GB=$(jac gatk.snv bcftools.snv); GF=$(jac gatk.snv freebayes.snv); BF=$(jac bcftools.snv freebayes.snv)
I3=$(comm -12 gatk.snv bcftools.snv | comm -12 - freebayes.snv | wc -l|tr -d ' ')
U3=$(cat gatk.snv bcftools.snv freebayes.snv | sort -u | wc -l|tr -d ' ')
J3=$(awk -v i=$I3 -v u=$U3 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f",(u>0)?i/u:0}')
{
  echo "gatk<->bcftools_jaccard  $GB  want >=0.90  (observed 0.9704)"
  echo "gatk<->freebayes_jaccard $GF  want >=0.85  (observed 0.9100)"
  echo "bcftools<->freebayes_jac $BF  want >=0.85  (observed 0.9103, the pair's own value)"
  echo "three_way_all_agree      $J3  want >=0.82  (observed 0.8963; $I3 of $U3 union SNVs called by all three)"
} > concordance.txt
cat concordance.txt
awk -v j=$GB 'BEGIN{exit !(j>=0.90)}'
awk -v j=$GF 'BEGIN{exit !(j>=0.85)}'
awk -v j=$BF 'BEGIN{exit !(j>=0.85)}'
awk -v j=$J3 'BEGIN{exit !(j>=0.82)}'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
